content: Cristo eynynâ ypemugudo, Deus ingâsedybylâ âmaemo, aunloenlâ eagâ mitomoem. Kynynâ aguenriem Deus Ingonotyby Jesus awyly xutuwâdaungâ, târâ Jerusalémdâ Deus ety oday kurâ domodo eynynâ aguewâni modo iwymâry kuru Deus agâ agueim ara. Awylygue, Jesus wâgâ mâpaunzebyra tâiseba itaungâ.
Deus aguehobyry idânârâ anhetuo, tynynonro modo eynynâ aguenriem itoem, aguehonwânmy Jesus, Deusram. Saguhoem Moisésram tynynonro modo eniem aguehobyry ara.
Mâkâ âtâ itâni tuomaenzeim kuru, intâdyby takaze kehoem. Arâ lâpylâ Jesus xyrendyly, Moisés takaze kehoem.
Ânguylâ âtâ tytâze lelâ; Deus olâ idânârâ tâlânro modo xugunipyry.

Tâzemary, tywymâry ety odano emyenro myakâwândy Moisés. Deus “Aiekâ” kehobyry adyese lelâ myakâwândy. Kurâ domodo Deus xurâ koendâ lelâ myakâwândy nhedyly, nhurudyly warâ. Wayam waunroem Deus agueho wâgâ aguewâm lâpylâmy.

Cristo Jesus olâ âtâ sodo imery kuru emyenro, Deus imery lelâlâ awylygue. Cristolâ âtâ oday xutuim kuru, Deus aguehobyry ara kehoem anhedyly. Kurâ Jesus einwânni modo, Kunwym Deus ety kurâ, ton-honre Jesus kieinwântuo, “Xuduze urâ” Deus kehobyry kinwânwânsezeduo warâ.
Deus Ispiritury aguehobyry enanâguewâdaungâ, Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ iwenibyem mawânrâ.

content.text: Mârâ ume, myarâ myarâ warâ âdy peba ato einkâ tadakobâdaymo, aguelymo:
‘Kyzene olegue Deus inakanhe aguidyly nhemaenly, kânagazenehombalâ’ kelymo.
toenzepa kâinane xurâmoem koendonro modo agânhedyly.
“Kyzene olegue Deus inakanhe aguidyly nhemaenly, kânagazenehombalâ” kelymo.
Awylygue eagâmo yewiâpadyly; ton-honre kehoem auguely:
auguehobyry ara âdaunloenlâ târâ nekobyzeguebamo ise warâ’ ”

content: kewândymy Deus kydamudo wâgâ, warâ iwenibyem awyly Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ.
Cristo eynynâ ypemugudo, tonomeguelâ itaungâ. Tâeganepa itaungâ, Deus agueho mankabyra mitoem, Deusdâ iwague mipyra mitomoem warâ.

Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ iwenibyem: “Iwerâ âyanmo Deus agueho mâindatuomo, tâeganepa itaungâ” kely. Saguhoem “iwerâ” kehobyry umelâ lâpylâ kurâ iwerâ. Awylygue agonromo eon-hondâdaungâ, Satanásram nâzenokuoba itomoem, Deus izepa ato aniempyra itomoem, tâeganepa itomoem, Deus einwândyly nimoba itomoem warâ.
Jesus kieinwândyly adaguhobyry aralâ, kyigueho odaji kehoem kieinwânsezedyly watay, idânârâ iwymâryem awyly ume mâkâ agâlâ ise kurâ.
Xirâ mawânrâ Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ agueho:
Ânguyka myakâwândy Deus neinwâmpyra ini, aguely tindadyly umelâ? Akaemo kydamudo Egitodâba Moisés nhatyby modo.
Ânguy agâka myakâwândy Deus quarenta anu lelâ iewiâky? Izepa ato aienibyry modo agâ myakâwândy iewiâky. Awylygue myakâwândy mârâ âji âdy peba atodâ iguelymo.

Ânguy wâgâka myakâwândy Deus ton-honre kehoem aguely: “ ‘Ynynonro modoram kâunduly’ ugueho onroam âdaunloenlâ naintaymbamo, negawântaymbamo warâ ise; auguehobyry ara âdaunloenlâ târâ nekobyzeguebamo ise warâ” kely? “Deus wâgâ kydâtynanâdaymba kine” keypy modo wâgâ myakâwândy mâkâ aguely.
Aituo tutuzelâ kurâ, “Ynynonro modoram xuduze urâ” Deus kehobyryam akaemo naimpyra atobyry, mâkâ tyeinwândyseba atomobyry wâgâ.
